$comment: Scripted calls for the two-track bench. `gapMs` is the pause before a line; negative overlaps the previous line. `you` is spoken into the mic track, `them` into the computer-audio track. `echo` leaks the computer audio into the mic, as happens on laptop speakers.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Morning everyone, can you all hear me alright?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Yes, loud and clear. Shall we start with the launch checklist?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Good idea. The release notes are still missing a section on pricing.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I will write that section today and send it to you before five.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Perfect. Then we ship on Friday afternoon.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Can everyone see the dashboard on my screen right now?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I can see it. The error rate looks much lower than last week.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: It dropped after we fixed the retry logic in the upload queue.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Great work. Let us add an alert so we notice if it climbs again.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: I will set that up this afternoon and share the link in the channel.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: So the budget for the next quarter is mostly going into hiring.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Are we hiring designers or only engineers this time?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Two engineers and one designer, starting in March.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Welcome to the design review, I have invited Priya as well.

lines.speaker: them2
lines.text: Hi everyone, I will walk you through the new onboarding screens.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Thanks Priya. Does the permission step come before pairing now?

lines.speaker: them2
lines.text: Yes, permissions first, then pairing, then a short test recording.
